image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated on a high balcony (tribune) within a stone cathedral or church. The organ features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, with the tallest pipes in the center and shorter ones flanking them. The instrument is housed in a decorative wooden case with carved details. Below the main pipe array is a balcony railing with intricate woodwork. The background shows stone arches and columns typical of Gothic architecture. A bright light source (window) is visible behind the upper left pipes.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the geometric depth audit results. AI generators often struggle with the repetitive, rigid geometry of pipe organs, sometimes causing pipes to merge or tilt unnaturally. Verify if the 'stepped' silhouette is mathematically consistent. Also, check if the lighting on the pipes matches the strong backlight from the window on the left.
